text:
marta: spotted a tiny billing delta after a prefetch+resume scenario during streaming. customer reported extra ~12 tokens. anyone seen similar?
noah: which flow? tool or normal generate?
marta: flow: prefetch sidecar -> node drain -> reconnection to another model route -> toolcall started then truncation/EOF mid-tool. Ledger shows both provisional and confirmed tool charges.
noah: logs?
marta: pasted snippet: ```INFO ledger: session=xyz789 event=provisional_charge type=tool tokens=14 prefix=2
INFO ledger: session=xyz789 event=confirmed_charge type=tool tokens=26 confirmed=true route=redwood-v1
INFO connect: session=xyz789 route_hint=blue-experimental reconnect=true
```
tara: looks like provisional recorded before handoff, confirmed recorded after reconnect to a different route. Our dedupe checks (session, type, confirmed) so provisional + confirmed both counted.
kylo: that fits. The provisional happens downstream of the prefetch sidecar; when the client resumes, the finalization goes through a different coordinator which doesn't see the provisional flag.
ops-bot: Alert: small billing delta detected for 1 account; estimated exposure $0.00045.
noah: quick mitigation idea: when ingesting a confirmed_charge, check for a provisional within a short window with similar prefix and same tool id; if found merge rather than emit duplicate billing event. But risk: can mask real double charges if two separate tool invocations happen quickly.
tara: we should surface a metric 'charge_merge_candidates' and a dashboard panel showing merged vs separate so ops can audit. Also add route_hint and session_phase (prefetch/resume) to ledger events to help attribution.
kylo: UI change: in the token waterfall show tiny merged badge and hover text listing provisional_token and confirmed_token counts. Also expose a debug trace link.
marta: can someone draft the dedupe rule and a telemetry plan? I'd like a canary for one tenant first.
noah: I'll open a small PR: ledger: add session_phase, route_hint fields; ingest: implement tentative merge logic behind flag; emit metrics: merged_candidates, merge_false_positive. Add unit tests + a tiny replay harness. ETA tomorrow morning.
tara: thanks. I'll make a console UX ticket for the merged badge and expanded timeline.
kylo: I'll add an alert to detect abnormal spikes in merge_false_positive to avoid hiding real billing issues.
marta: perfect, tagging @billing-squad for FYI. Thanks team :thumbsup:
